svg.title: AIPlex brand sheet
svg.desc: Overview of the AIPlex identity: mark construction, lockups, clear space and minimum sizes, palette with contrast ratios, module colours and icons, and usage examples.

g.text: Grid 32 × 32 units; heavy lines every 4 units
Lane stroke 4 units (1/8 of the grid)
Outer lanes turn 45° at x = 6 and meet the gate
Butt caps, mitre joins, no rounding
16 px: 1 unit = 0.5 px, lanes 2 px on whole pixels
Wordmark: cap height 24, stem 4 = lane stroke
App icon: mark shifted 0.8 units left of centre
G = gate width (12 units at mark scale). Keep G clear on every side of any lockup or mark.
Neutrals. Body text: Ink on white 17.26:1; muted text neutral-600 on white 7.93:1; on dark, Ink (dark) on neutral-950 16.28:1 and neutral-400 6.07:1.
Status: text colour on its tint, on page background (light | dark)
Module colours and icon family (24 px grid, 2 px stroke, gate square)
Neighbours in navigation order alternate lightness and hue; simulated protan, deutan and tritan OKLab distance ≥ 0.13 for every adjacent pair.
Access Point, Identity and Usage are shared services; Agent, User and Client are caller kinds. They use Ink, not a module hue.
